author: 1rnl
content: Decision: the classifier operates on its OWN sorted surface syntax (faithful to metatheory GH#2 §1.2) defined in Strat/Nnf.lean, NOT REQ-1's Frm. REQ-1 shipped a minimal SEMANTIC spine (single carrier, unsorted all/ex, Tm.var only, qf opaque); the admission traps (nested-read self-loop, cast cycle) are properties of the sort+term structure (Read/Cast/sorted binders) REQ-1's Frm cannot express. REQ-1's Frm stays the semantic/encoder spine; the encoder (REQ-5) bridges them.
